items.Sentence: The secondary treatment system at the Facility consists of a headworks and flow diverter, two aerated ponds (Ponds 1 and 2) operated in parallel, followed by an additional aerated pond (Pond 4) for settling and polishing before being pumped to the tertiary treatment system which consists of tertiary filtration and ultraviolet light (UV) disinfection.

Pond 3 is currently out of service
Pond 5 is no longer used for storage of treated wastewater.
Un-disinfected, secondary treated wastewater is stored on-site in an unlined storage reservoir (Pond 6).

Title 22 tertiary treated effluent is collected in a recycled water storage tank and then conveyed to Pond NC-2D at the CVGC to be used for golf course irrigation or to provide makeup water for the wetland system.
The Discharger plans to install a dissolved air floatation system for filter pretreatment to address seasonal issues related to algae, coloring, and tannins in water sourced from Pond 6.
The Discharger also plans to replace the current tertiary filter and may install a second filter for flexibility and equipment redundancy.

Other improvements during this phase may include installation of a second redundant UV disinfection system, building expansion, addition of emergency power for the tertiary treatment system, and site improvements for drainage.
